spreadsheeteditor-desc: Allows embedding and editing of excel-like spreadsheets
spreadsheeteditor-i18n-welcome: Welcome to the localization file of the SpreadsheetEditor extension.
spreadsheeteditor-helloworld-intro: Welcome to the "Hello world" special page of the SpreadsheetEditor extension.
spreadsheeteditor-ac-label-placeholder: Short name shown in the popup header
spreadsheeteditor-ac-category-hint: Picking a category auto-fills the query template below.
spreadsheeteditor-ac-query-hint: Placeholders: {{{user_input}}} = what the user types · {{{cell:A1}}} = value of A1 (absolute) · {{{col:A}}} = value of column A in the same row. Result page UUIDs are written to the cell; the label overlay handles display.
spreadsheeteditor-ac-default-hint: Fills empty cells of the range with this value on Add.
spreadsheeteditor-popup-hint: Type to search · press Enter to clear the cell · Esc to cancel
spreadsheeteditor-notify-editor-open:
Another editor is currently open.
Please save your work and close it first.
spreadsheeteditor-notify-unsupported-fil: Unsupported file type. Please upload .xlsx, .xls or .csv
